DEFINITION · qeva:1:vector-space@1

Vector space

A vector space supports vector addition and scalar multiplication under compatibility laws.

editoriallinear-algebra · geometry
Trace this conceptSearch connections

PLAIN

The idea

A vector space supports vector addition and scalar multiplication under compatibility laws.

EXACT

The compact statement

A vector space V over field F is an abelian group under + with an action F×V→V satisfying distributive, associative, and identity axioms.

Example

ℝ² is a vector space over ℝ.

Boundary / caveat

The scalar field is part of the structure.
